site: Workday (Marathon Petroleum Create Account; every Workday form field error)
class: The site's own error text was shown in a form the agent did not read, so a refusal reached the owner as 'the site kept the form open' with no words
symptom: Marathon's Create Account was pressed and refused; four runs stopped with no reason because the agent could not see why.
root_cause:
_visible_error_texts read only role=alert and class '...error'. Workday renders each field error as

Please check the box to continue

with an 'Error :' prefix and sets aria-invalid on the field.
why_tests_missed: The error fixtures used role=alert, the shape other portals use; none had Workday's.
fix: _visible_error_texts also reads [data-automation-id=inputAlert] and drops the 'Error :' prefix, so the stop carries the site's own words.
prevention: Take each portal's real error markup from a captured page, not from the markup most portals use; and make every refusal carry the site's words.
